items.title: The Suplex That Punishes a Bad Sprawl
items.hook: He tried to sprawl. He ended up in the air instead.
items.script:
Format: technique breakdown — front body lift suplex.

Alt hooks:
2. “This is what happens when you sprawl wrong.”
3. “Everyone defends the takedown, nobody defends this.”

items.script:
Format: funny skit.

items.title: Why You Train When No One's Watching
items.hook: Nobody claps for the empty gym at 5am.
items.script:
Format: motivational b-roll.

Alt hooks:
2. “This is the part they don't put on the highlight reel.”
3. “You don't rise to the match, you fall to your training.”
